correctness.rationale: Over R=k[epsilon]/(epsilon^2), D=A+epsilon B satisfies D²=0 iff A²=0 and AB+BA=0. Contractible unit pivots of reduction A split off r acyclic rank-two summands, leaving epsilon C on R^h, h=n-2r, with C induced on ker A/im A. With s=rank C, c=dim(ker C cap im C), cycles/boundaries show H(D)≅R^(h-s-c)⊕k^(2c), underlying k-rank(D)=2r+s. Counting square-zero A by kernel/image flags, q^(2r(n-r)) free lift parameters, and the rank-s C subspace intersection c yields N=[n r]_q[n-r r]_q |GL_r| q^(2r(n-r)) [h h-s]_q [h-s c]_q [s s-c]_q q^((h-s-c)(s-c)) |GL_s|, including all boundary cases. An independently implemented direct enumeration of all 2x2 matrices A,B over F_2 and F_3 satisfying original equations reproduced all (r,s,c) counts (F2: 1,6,3,6,12; F3: 1,24,8,48,72). This exhaustive small-size check corroborates the general flag proof, not replaces it.
